decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 1100 hours to 0000 hours Friday to Saturday, and 1100 hours to 2300 hours Sunday to Thursday, and motorised delivery vehicles shall not use the premises outside of these hours
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 6 - No vehicle shall be parked on pavement in front of No 317 Chiswick High Road, and no external seating shall be placed on the pavement in front of No 317 Chiswick High Road. Vehicles must only be parked in on-street parking bays along Chiswick High Road or the allocated parking spaces provided to the rear of the site.
